description: The VSB conductor-discharge team publishes high-resolution contactless antenna measurements of partial and corona discharges on XLPE-covered conductors. The own Figshare record contains one ZIP archive and links CC BY 4.0 rights. The article says each raw binary sample spans 20 milliseconds with ten million analogue-voltage points, and the archive groups measurements by discharge condition. Such waveforms can calibrate signal-detection or condition-monitoring components in electric-line simulations. Coverage is a controlled test setting, not a long operating history on a distribution network. A caveat is that antenna placement, background noise and conductor geometry affect signatures; a classifier validated here cannot be assumed reliable on field lines. The loading utilities have a separate GitHub address. I read own Figshare metadata and article Data Records without downloading binary files, training a model or assessing electrical safety. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
